name: SDCG
recent: SDCG 近期出现董事及主要股东 Edison Kong 的股权变动申报，涉及 600 万股普通股的转让，但实益所有权不变。公司也宣布了首席财务官等主要管理人员的变动。最新季度财报显示营收和净利均同比增长。
notable: 董事经理 Edison Kong 转让 600 万股普通股，实益所有权不变。
公司宣布两名主要管理人员变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 1062.5 万令吉，环比增长 47.2%，同比增长 115.4%；净利为 69.8 万令吉，同比增长 67.0%，净利率为 6.6%，较去年同期的 -6.7% 转正。

recent_en: SDCG recently saw director and substantial shareholder Edison Kong's interest change announcements involving a transfer of 6 million ordinary shares, with no change in beneficial ownership. The company also announced changes in principal officers, including the CFO. The latest quarterly results show revenue and net profit both grew year-on-year.
notable_en: Managing Director Edison Kong transferred 6 million ordinary shares with no change in beneficial ownership.
The company announced changes in two principal officers.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 10.625 million, up 47.2% QoQ and 115.4% YoY; net profit was MYR 698,000, up 67.0% YoY, with a net margin of 6.6% versus -6.7% a year earlier.
